name: Raise 2048 solver avg score (expspawn retrain, no eval-seed overfit)

description: Baseline: shipped 128/32 net (base TD, 300k) on new held-out seed 9200, 20 games, 2-ply.

asi.note: seed 9200 is easier than 9000; use it for iteration only, confirm on 9300/9400

description: 1M-schedule base run: evaluated its ~210k checkpoint (lr still 0.0024), then annealed 70k more games at lr 0.0022. 2-ply stuck at ~76k with 0/20 8192 despite 1-ply recovering to 57.9k.

asi.cost: 1M run killed at ~210k after 52 min; anneal 70k = 926 s, 145.2M moves, 157k moves/s
asi.hypothesis: Stretching the built-in linear lr decay over 1M games would let more data pay off; a short late anneal from the mid-run checkpoint should recover the 300k-schedule quality.
asi.lesson: The 1M schedule keeps lr ~2x the 300k schedule at the same game count. A noisy V (high lr late) is usable for 1-ply greedy but poisons 2-ply max-over-second-moves: 1-ply 57.9k vs shipped 60.9k, but 2-ply 75.8k vs 134.9k. Annealing 70k from a noisy point does not fix the V ranking.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not stretch the decay; keep the shipped 300k schedule. Try train seed 2/3 at the same 300k recipe, and/or a faster-decay 400k run.
asi.result: 210k checkpoint at lr 0.0024 = 74.4k/10 games; +70k anneal to lr 2e-4 = 75.8k/20, 0/20 8192, 1-ply 57.9k. 2-ply did not recover.

description: Train seed 2 with the shipped 300k recipe (base, lr 0.003, par sqrt): diverged at 50,440/300,000 games

asi.cause: with train_games=300k the built-in decay gives lr 0.00255 at 50k, vs 0.00165 for the docs' 100k runs; seed 1 survives this, seed 2 does not
asi.failure: diverged at 50440/300000 games (non-finite or |w| > 1e6), not saving /tmp/base300k_s2c.bin; error: Diverged
asi.hypothesis: seed 2 at the shipped 300k schedule would give an independent sample of the same recipe
asi.lesson: the shipped 0.003 schedule sits at the stability edge; do not run seed 2 without a lower lr or a divergence guard
asi.next_action_hint: seed 3 only if a stable schedule is chosen; keep checkpoints

description: Train seed 1 300k at lr 0.002 (decay to 0.0002), evaluate the 250k checkpoint

asi.hypothesis: lr 0.002 for 300k would be more stable than 0.003 and give a better final V
asi.killed_at: 250000/300000 games by the 5400 s tool timeout
asi.lesson: lower lr undertrains at the same game budget; the shipped 0.003 schedule is better. This matches docs #135/#204 that game count and lr shape are already at the recipe's peak
asi.next_action_hint: do not lower the schedule lr to stabilize seeds; instead keep shipped lr and use checkpoints

description: SWA: average the last 4/8/16/32 checkpoints of a fresh 300k run and evaluate (best avg4 118,981.8)

asi.hypothesis: averaging nearby SGD checkpoints (SWA / Polyak averaging) smooths V and improves 2-ply ranking
asi.run: fresh 300k shipped-recipe run, killed at 285k; 57 unique checkpoints in /tmp/swa
asi.lesson: averaging raises 1-ply but destroys 2-ply, same signature as low-lr fine-tuning: the averaged V stops being the search-compatible value. SWA over 20k+ games is a dead end
asi.reproducibility: fresh 300k run does NOT reproduce shipped (116.9k at 285k vs 134.9k); nn.zig changed since the 2026-11-06 shipped net (#289/#321/#348), so each long run is a fresh sample with ~±6-8k variance; shipped may be a high draw
asi.caution: 4-point SWA sweep is a single run, not a controlled A/B
asi.next_action_hint: do not pursue checkpoint averaging; treat 134.9k as a high-variance target and require fresh-seed confirmation

description: phase_h6: full-width 3-ply only in the low-empty endgame (2-ply at >=4 empties). Seed 9200 +12.6k (147,442.8, 18/20 8192) looked strong, but seed 9300 paired diff was +10,801.8 +/- 10,050.1 and seed 9400 unpaired was +747.6 (134,452.8 vs 133,705.2, 8192 15/20 vs 16/20). No reliable score gain at 4.0-4.7x ms/move; 20-game seed noise is ~+/-10k.

asi.bugs_found: Phase.max_empty default must be 16 (empty 4x4 board); 15 caused an unreachable in phaseDepth for the .deep schedule. min_empty=3 alone also matches 4+ empties, so an 'exactly 3' row needs an upper bound.
asi.cost: 4.11 ms/move at 9200, 4.73 at 9400, 15.04 in the serial pairrow process; 3,852-3,935 leaves/move vs 980-986 for 2-ply
asi.dead_ends: 3-ply only at <=2 empties: 127,852.2 (-7k, 2.15x); sampled 2 spawns in the 3-ply tree: 60,533 (-74k, policy collapses); 3-ply only at exactly 3 empties: 4.29x cost, 119,384.8 on 5 games (the 3-empty root tree dominates cost).
asi.hypothesis: 3-ply expectimax restricted to <=3 empty cells buys the 8192 tail cheaply (between the shipped 2-ply and the 12.7x full 3-ply).
asi.next_action_hint: Stop tuning endgame depth; it is a cost curve, not a free win. If depth is revisited, add a min_max_tile condition so only 4096+ tail boards pay for 3-ply, and confirm with pairrow on 2 seeds.
asi.noise_floor: 20 games on one seed: ~+/-10k; identical recipe reruns at 300k differ by ~+/-8k (fresh 285k run = 116,965.8 vs shipped 134,867.2).
asi.why_rejected: The gain does not replicate on a third seed and is under 1.1 sigma on the paired seed; at 4x ms/move it fails the +20% latency budget and is not a real score improvement.
